scope: Read-only native system-library symbol pin to reference circuit mapping. Reference SH may split into distinct native mechanical pads. No footprint or symbol import. Pin compatibility does not certify native footprint geometry or PCB DRC.

geometry_conditions.detail: Native EP17 is approximately1.70mm chamfered polygon, unlike r14 1.68mm square. Native library has no four0.30mm thermal holes and no relieved stencil. Board-level manufacture redesign and new CAM/tolerance review required.

Prefer native C704850/device12eb0e5acf26481ea5fa90cc786bcfdd/fpa1e306874b2643a4b73e1579b039e46e: nominal0.25mm wide pads match r14 requirement; C2845237 has0.30mm widths. Both preserve pin1..10 functions. Reference pad8 split stencil not present by default.

Exact DMM native library has six outer signal pads plus four quadrants all numbered4. It does not contain0.60mm NPTH hole. Native board needs actual acoustic hole centered on ring and bottom/inner keepout; cannot count silkscreen circle as drill.

Native ESP32 library has nine0.90mm square SMD pads numbered41; reference has3.9mm EP plus12 drilled ground contacts. Native does not include those12 holes. Review ground/thermal implementation and antenna keepout anew.
EP pin17 and9 preserved respectively, but exact dimensions/paste split must be checked against actual native geometry and manufacture constraints.
